messages:
Tori: Quick onboard check-in — what I did: finished dotfiles, installed rust/go, cloned monorepo and ran tests locally. Got my laptop and MFA set up.
Sam: Nice! welcome :tada: — can you paste the GCP project ID and which env you need GPU in?
Tori: Project is redwood-dev-42, need a single A100 in 'private-dev' for the kernel debugging walkthrough.
Tori: Blockers: no sudo on staging (can't run the local deploy script), VPN keeps dropping around 10–15 mins, and I don't have GPU quota.
Sam: Got it. I'll open infra ticket for sudo + GPU. For VPN try the quick fix from docs if it drops: `sudo systemctl restart openvpn` then reconnect.
infra-bot: Ticket INF-4721 created by Sam for Tori: "grant dev-sudo group + GPU quota request" — assigned to Jamal, priority P2.
Jamal: Looking into INF-4721. @Tori I need the manager approval in the ticket and your GCP IAM email. Also which zone do you prefer? (us-west1 or us-central1)
Tori: Sent DM with my work email. Prefer us-west1 for latency.
Ashley: Approved GPU quota and sudo addition for Tori.
Jamal: Thanks Ashley, I'll add Tori to group `dev-sudo` once infra validation completes. GPU quota request submitted — ETA 1 business day.
Mika: Small heads-up — if you hit git-lfs issues, run `git lfs install` then `git lfs pull`. We added a note to onboarding-setup about the MFA + keychain quirk.
Sam: Also pinging @tori about two tiny onboarding PRs (welcome doc + DNS entry) — can you sign the CLA and push the commits after sudo is enabled?
Tori: CLA signed earlier today. I'll wait for sudo then push and ping for review.
Sam: Awesome. If VPN still flakes after the restart, file a network ticket and tag #eng-infra.
Tori: Will do. Thanks everyone — will update this thread after infra confirms. :thumbsup:
